notes.subject: ⟨A yɛrɛ⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb יחדל has no explicit subject; the 'he' (Elohim, min Job ka kuma) is supplied in brackets

notes.subject: kuma Yawe fɛ
notes.rationale: Ayuba b'a kuma bɔ Ala fɛ直接 — a bɛ Yawe de wele ni nin kumasen ye

notes.subject: מעט … מעט
notes.rationale: מעט filan nin verse kɔnɔ: tile dɔɔnin, hɛrɛ dɔɔnin — wuli-wuliko min bɔla Bamanankan na

notes.subject: יחדל
notes.rationale: An b'a fɔ ka jɔsi ye min bɛ to: Yawe k'a jɔsi ni Yawe k'a bila Ayuba la — hɛrɛ ta cogo minna, kelen-kelen bɛ ta ye

translation: Wala ne ka tilew tɛ dɔɔnin ye? ⟨A yɛrɛ⟩ jɔsi k'a bɔ ne la, walasa ne bɛna dɔɔnin hɛrɛ ta.
